scope.purpose: User-authorized checkpoint cleanup on 2026-09-09; one last loadable finite checkpoint per independent run/arm/seed; no experiment restart.
scope.excluded: All other roots, including separately owned historical BAFDR compute trees, H65 matched90, original AdaTAD/pretrained checkpoints, GeoSparse, BCR, and older unrelated DUCA/ZoomToken routes.
